findings.text: Atlas component page Overview for Button renders no buttons: the atlas runs preview.html as an about:srcdoc iframe, so new URL('../bundle.js',location.href) throws "Invalid URL" (variant tabs render; only the landing Overview breaks). Broken since round 1 (033fa58).
findings.result: fixed: preview.html no longer fetches/constructs URLs; Overview shows Primary, Secondary, Text action, Hold (danger + primary), Tool, Destructive; console clean.

findings.text: Farrowing Scan ear tag still renders class "button primary button primary dock-scan" (the End walk doubling, fixed only on Inspection).
findings.result: fixed: farrowing btn() strips button/primary; Scan ear tag renders "button primary dock-scan"; no duplicate class tokens on any screen checked.

findings.text: README tokens list space-1, which tokens.css does not define (the CSS uses border-width).
Destructive preview's disabled reason is a piglet reason ("Choose the piglets first.").
findings.result: fixed: destructive reason is "Saved records keep their photos."

Six variants each with a use line and real screens.
Press moves 2px; disabled text action and tool now use disabled ink; waiting grey.

390x844 bare: Scan ear tag 217x48, End walk 95x48, tools 111x48, Back 86x48 (86x56 beside a hold), Untick 79x48, hold 248-254x56; nothing under 48 on farrowing.finish/room, inspection.walk/filters/pen/review-selected/actions, piglet sheet-todo/give-ids/end-task, workbench.choose-unit.
Two footer actions, three tools; screens respect it.
Disabled and waiting carry a visible reason line; not colour-only.
Registered verbs; an ellipsized tool label keeps its full name in title.
Native button, aria-disabled waiting, aria-busy, two-press hold, Escape cancels.
Component and host CSS on tokens; README now lists border-width. Every variant specimen page still writes border-bottom:var(--space-1) (undefined token) - harness only, low.
Atlas Overview now renders all six variant cells; every variant tab renders all cells; console clean, no 404s; 390x844 screens have no horizontal scroll.
